oe_cel_ci_enfeoff_fanwang = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_CHINA_ACTIONS
	ai_tick = never
	use_in_automation = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		scope:actor = {
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = { at_war = no }
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			is_subject_of = scope:actor
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_any_celestial_subject = yes }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_protected_yuan_province = yes }
			NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia }
			country_type = location
		}
		enabled = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_cel_ci_kin_or_loyal_tt
				OR = {
					subject_loyalty >= 60
					AND = {
						has_ruler = yes
						scope:actor = { has_ruler = yes }
						ruler ?= { dynasty ?= scope:actor.ruler.dynasty }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			scope:recipient = {
				change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_fanwang
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
			change_celestial_authority = { value = celestial_authority_very_weak_penalty }
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_first_fief_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_first_fief_done value = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { oe_cel_is_han_ming_track = yes }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.3
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { oe_cel_is_manchu_qing_track = yes }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.4
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -100
	}
}

	type = diplomacy

	ai_tick = never
	use_in_automation = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		scope:actor = {
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = { at_war = no }
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_cel_ci_revoke_cd
		years = 2
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			is_subject_of = scope:actor
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			custom_tooltip = oe_cel_ci_revoke_tt
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = { subject_loyalty >= 45 }
					scope:actor = { oe_cel_revocation_heat_value < 3 }
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal
					add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_cel_op_revoked }
				}
				scope:actor = {
					oe_cel_bump_revocation_tension = yes
					add_prestige = 5
				}
			}
			else = {
				scope:recipient = {
					add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_cel_op_revoked }
				}
				scope:actor = {
					oe_cel_bump_revocation_tension = yes
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_rebel_fief value = scope:recipient }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.6
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -100
	}
}

oe_cel_ci_charter_grand_duhu = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_CHINA_ACTIONS
	ai_tick = never
	use_in_automation = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		scope:actor = {
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_jimi_sihai_duhu } }
				gold >= 150
			}
			trigger_else = {
				gold >= 200
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			is_subject_of = scope:actor
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_any_celestial_subject = yes }
			NOT = { oe_cel_is_protected_yuan_province = yes }
			NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia }
			country_type = location
		}
		enabled = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_cel_ci_far_capital_tt
				capital ?= {
					NOT = { sub_continent = scope:actor.capital.sub_continent }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_jimi_sihai_duhu } }
					add_gold = -150
				}
				else = {
					add_gold = -200
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						oe_cel_zone_count_value >= 6
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_six_zones_done }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_six_zones_done value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.24
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						oe_cel_zone_count_value >= 3
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_three_zones_done }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_three_zones_done value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.12
				}
				else = {
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.11
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -100
	}
}

	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_CHINA_ACTIONS
	ai_tick = never
	use_in_automation = no

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		scope:actor = {
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			stability >= 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { international_organization_has_policy = policy:introduce_gaituguiliu_policy } }
				gold >= 110
			}
			trigger_else = {
				gold >= 150
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			is_subject_of = scope:actor
			OR = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
				is_subject_type = tusi
			}
			country_type = location
		}
		enabled = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_cel_ci_gtgl_not_pending_tt
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_gtgl_marked }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			custom_tooltip = oe_cel_ci_gtgl_tt
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { international_organization_has_policy = policy:introduce_gaituguiliu_policy } }
					add_gold = -110
				}
				else = {
					add_gold = -150
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_gtgl_iron_commandery } }
				scope:actor = {
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_gtgl_unrest_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
					annex_country = { country = scope:recipient reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
					random_list = {
						60 = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.14 }
						40 = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.16 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_gtgl_provincial_wave } }
				scope:recipient = {
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_gtgl_marked value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_gtgl_due years = 5 }
					add_liberty_desire = 10
				}
				scope:actor = {
					random_list = {
						30 = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.14 }
						70 = { }
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				scope:recipient = {
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_gtgl_marked value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_cel_gtgl_due years = 10 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -100
	}
}

	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			is_subject_of = scope:actor
			OR = {
				oe_cel_is_any_celestial_subject = yes
				is_subject_type = tributary
			}
		}
		enabled = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_cel_ci_kanhe_ready_tt
				NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_cel_kanhe_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			scope:recipient = {
				add_cooldown = { type = oe_cel_kanhe_cd years = 5 }
				add_liberty_desire = 5
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_cel_op_kanhe_audit }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = {
					value = scope:recipient.monthly_income_trade_and_tax
					multiply = 3
					min = 10
					max = 500
				}
			}
			change_celestial_authority = { value = celestial_authority_very_weak_bonus }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -100
	}
}
